title: Teaching Yourself Through Videos
paragraphs: When his car starts making an unusual noise, Bayu decides to watch several repair videos online instead of paying for a mechanic, hoping to save money and learn a useful new skill at the same time.
The first video makes the repair look simple, but once he opens the hood himself, the actual parts look far more complicated and unfamiliar than anything shown in the short clip.

After pausing and rewinding the video several times, comparing it carefully against his own engine, Bayu slowly identifies the correct part and manages to complete the repair himself after nearly two hours.
Proud of the small victory, he tells his brother that watching a video is easy, but actually applying it patiently with your own hands is where the real learning happens.
